description_en: Invokes the ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations operation to query the destination configurations of an endpoint group for a custom route listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations接口查询终端节点组的映射信息配置列表（自定义路由类型监听）
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query destination configurations
parameters.help_zh: 待查询映射信息配置的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the backend service of the endpoint group. Valid values:

TCP: TCP protocol.

UDP: UDP protocol.

TCP,UDP: TCP and UDP protocols.

If this parameter is left empty, all protocol types are queried.

You can specify up to 10 protocol entries
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务的协议类型。取值：

TCP：TCP协议。

UDP：UDP协议。

TCP,UDP：TCP和UDP协议。

为空时查询所有协议类型。

您最多可输入10个协议信息
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en:
The start port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口
parameters.name: from_port

parameters.help_en:
The end port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The value of FromPort must be less than or equal to the value of ToPort
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口
parameters.name: to_port

Destinations.description_en: The destination configurations of the endpoint group
Destinations.description_zh: 终端节点组的映射信息

DestinationId.description_zh: 终端关节点组映射信息配置ID

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the destination configuration belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 映射信息配置所属的终端节点组ID

FromPort.description_en: The start port of the backend service of the endpoint group
FromPort.description_zh: 终端节点组后端服务起始端口

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener to which the endpoint group destination configuration belongs
ListenerId.description_zh: 终端节点组映射信息配置所属的监听ID

Protocols.description_en:
The Protocol Type of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Protocols.description_zh:
终端节点组后端服务协议类型。

UDP：UDP协议。

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service to which the managed instance belongs.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:  

true: The instance is managed.  

false: The instance is not managed
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：  

true：是托管实例。  

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance.
This parameter is valid only when ServiceManaged is set to True.
When the instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。
仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that the user can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference or be referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.
CreateChild: Create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:
Listener: listener resource.
IpSet: acceleration region resource.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group resource.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule resource.
Endpoint: endpoint resource.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping resource of the endpoint group under a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: endpoint traffic policy resource under a custom routing listener.
This parameter is valid only when Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. The user cannot perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. The user can perform the action specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

ToPort.description_en: The end port of the backend service of the endpoint group
ToPort.description_zh: 终端节点组后端服务结束端口

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
